title: Unrun Term and Serving Age in Workplace Cafe Management Program Exit Billing
content:
Where twelve or more whole months of the contracted term stood unrun on the day written notice of termination was given and the cafe has been serving for fewer than twenty-four whole months, the months charged are the long remaining term exit months; where twelve or more whole months of the contracted term stood unrun on the day written notice of termination was given and the cafe has been serving for twenty-four whole months or more, the months charged are the settled site exit months; and where fewer than twelve whole months of the contracted term stood unrun on the day written notice of termination was given, the months charged are the number of monthly management fees printed against the service model.

**The two named quantities.** Across the Workplace Cafe Management Program the long remaining term exit months are 5 and the settled site exit months are 3.

**How the two counts are read.** The whole months of the contracted term standing unrun are counted from the day written notice of termination was given to the last day of the contracted term. The whole months the cafe has been serving are counted from the day the cafe began serving to the day the charge is raised.

**The clause set out as condition and result.**

| Whole months of the contracted term standing unrun on the day written notice of termination was given | Whole months the cafe has been serving | Months charged |
|---|---|---|
| 12 or more | fewer than 24 | the long remaining term exit months, being 5 |
| 12 or more | 24 or more | the settled site exit months, being 3 |
| fewer than 12 | immaterial | the number of monthly management fees printed against the service model |

**At the boundaries, on hypothetical figures.** Where exactly 12 whole months of the contracted term stood unrun on the day written notice of termination was given and the cafe had been serving 24 whole months, twelve or more whole months stood unrun and the cafe has been serving for twenty-four whole months or more, so the months charged are 3. Where those same 12 whole months stood unrun and the cafe had been serving 23 whole months, the cafe has been serving for fewer than twenty-four whole months, so the months charged are 5. Where 11 whole months stood unrun on that day, fewer than twelve whole months stood unrun and the serving age does not bear on the outcome: the months charged are the number of monthly management fees printed against the service model.
